_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No visible phase-score breaker in the coil; ETF flows floored and positioning crowded but vol/funding/liquidity still neutral, so score drifts one rung up into Complacency rather than a directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on phase, only risk-on metals tone
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC range-bound, Fear & Greed ~40-55, no sustained ETF-flow impulse or vol expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: fast flush with F&G under 35 and funding negative, or ETF-flow rebound reclaiming 30d momentum
